content.json:
# Identity Security Operations
Monitor successful and failed authentication, risky access, legacy clients, and privileged identity changes. Investigate trends together with Conditional Access and device context.

content.title: Sign-in outcomes over time
content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Outcome=iff(ResultType == 0, 'Success', 'Failure')
| summarize SignIns=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Outcome
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Risky successful sign-ins
content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == 0
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium', 'high') or RiskLevelAggregated in~ ('medium', 'high')
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AuthenticationRequirement, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.title: Successful legacy authentication by client
content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == 0
| where ClientAppUsed in~ ('Exchange ActiveSync', 'Other clients', 'IMAP4', 'MAPI Over HTTP', 'POP3', 'Authenticated SMTP')
| summarize SignIns=count(), Users=dcount(UserPrincipalName) by ClientAppUsed
| order by SignIns desc

content.title: Recent role and application credential changes
content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Category in~ ('RoleManagement', 'ApplicationManagement')
| where OperationName has_any ('Add member to role', 'credentials', 'Certificates and secrets')
| extend Initiator=coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))
| project TimeGenerated, Category, OperationName, Result, Initiator, TargetResources, CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
